title: Better For Adults Than For Kids
review_text: These are much longer, or wider depending on how you look at them. The wipes measure 20x30cms or 7.8 x 11.8 inches. They're quite soft and perfect for adults rather than kids. If you've got kids you've likely already got wipes. As an adult these are nicer to use and easier to clean yourself off with. The only thing I don't like is the scent, it's very lemony and feels like you're getting cleaned with lemon scented furniture polish. The scent clears quickly and there's no need to rinse after using this product these would be great to carry in the car or out hiking or camping though you need pack the used product out I'm not sure if they're biodegradable or can be disposed of in fire but there's a prominent 'do not flush' warning on the package. So, while they're fine for kids and can be used on their faces with the famous 'no more tears' guarantee I don't know why you'd regularly carry two types of wipes with you. But in the car for emergency clean-ups, in your gym bag or backpack for a quick freshening they're great for adults.
sentence: These are much longer, or wider depending on how you look at them.

title: Good gate, but could be better!
review_text:
I absolutely love this gate even though I've found 1 flaw with it. It's not the old one. I think it was called the lift & lock gate. I got this one because the old one my husband finally broke so I needed another one for the top of the stairs. All the other gates are expensive & since we have a baby and a toddler the old one wouldn't do. I went to Babies 'r Us & found this gate. It seemed perfect since our stairway is wider than most. I have to admit it was a pain to put together because I put all the screws in to hold the gate together only to find that they have to be really loose to adjust it to the right length. No problem just tighten them enough where the buttons don't fall off. It's not that hard to install the hinges if you're using the hardware mount. You don't need the templates if you have 2 people. Just lengthen the gate, slide it in the hinges then once it's against the wall have 1 person slide the gate out then the other drill them into place. Plus this gate will slide out the hinges if you want to move it somewhere else or take it with you to use it as a pressure mount. And that's where it's not a "GREAT" but still a well worth it.

You do have to loosen the screws to adjust the gate then tighten the screws again to have the gate fit other areas. With the lift & lock gate once it was unlocked you could adjust it to whatever fit you needed. You didn't have to worry about screwing anything in. But sometimes with the other gate it was a hassle to slide it closed when the little hinges would come out of their holes which is why my husband finally broke out out of frustration when trying to adjust it. It's probably why they didn't make this one the same way. Plus, it allows us to simply unlock the gate & swing it out of the way so both our toddler & ourselves can do it one-handed to get up or down the stairs without having to unlock it and readjust it using the pressure mounted system. That REQUIRED both hands. All in all I think this gate is definitely worth the money with it's versatility and ease of use. So much so that we bought 2, 1 for the top & bottom of our stairs.

Oh, & it does have Smart Technology which is great. But if you have uneven walls like mine it won't show green; however, the gate is still secure. My husband yanks on it to make sure it's closed.
sentence: I absolutely love this gate even though I've found 1 flaw with it.
